out.words: What is the new partner's share of goodwill (premium for goodwill)?
The amount of premium brought in by the new partner is shared by the existing partners in their ___.
What is reconstitution of a partnership firm?
If nothing is specified, how is the new partner assumed to acquire his share from the old partners?
Assertion: Premium received from a new partner on admission is credited to the old partners' capital accounts. Reason: Such premium is a capital receipt and not a revenue item.
Formula: an old partner's new share when the share he surrenders to the new partner is given.
Formula: the sacrifice by a partner.

Case: Firm's balance sheet shows goodwill of ₹40,000. On admission, partners decide to write off goodwill against partners' capitals (old ratio 2:1). Which single-line effect on the balance sheet results immediately after writing off?
Journal entry: new partner brings premium for goodwill in cash through the firm (first entry).
If a firm's existing goodwill is ₹40,000 and a new partner is admitted, this goodwill is typically:
Goodwill premium credited to old partners is retained in business: what additional entry is passed?

In each independent case, a new partner brings a cash premium for goodwill, and the existing partners sacrifice part of their shares. Match each situation in List-I with its accounting treatment in List-II. List-I (A) The new partner pays the premium directly and privately to the existing partners. (B) The premium is received through the firm and initially credited to Premium for Goodwill A/c. (C) The premium is received through the firm and initially credited to the new partner’s capital account before distribution to the sacrificing partners. (D) The premium has been credited to the existing partners’ capital accounts in their sacrificing ratio, and they retain the amount in the business. List-II (I) No entry is passed in the firm’s books. (II) Bank A/c Dr. to Premium for Goodwill A/c; then Goodwill A/c Dr. to the sacrificing partners’ capital accounts individually. (III) Bank A/c Dr. to the new partner’s capital account; then the new partner’s capital account Dr. to the sacrificing partners’ capital accounts individually. (IV) No additional entry is passed for retaining the credited amounts in the business. Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
Goodwill, if existing in the books of the firm, it is ___ at the time of admission of a partner.
Goodwill appearing in the books will be ___ by debiting old partners' capital accounts in their ___.
When a new partner is admitted and the existing partners give up part of their share in favour of the newcomer, the ratio in which the existing partners surrender their shares is called:
